# MakeFlow

> An independent SEO practice in Australia. Technical SEO, local SEO, on-page
> and content SEO, plus AEO and GEO so businesses are named in AI answers too.

MakeFlow does SEO and nothing else. The work gets businesses found on Google,
in the local map pack, and named by AI assistants such as ChatGPT when a
customer asks who to use.

## Services

- Technical SEO: crawling, indexing, site speed, Core Web Vitals, schema and
  crawler access for Googlebot and AI crawlers.
- Local SEO: Google Business Profile, suburb and service-area pages, reviews
  and consistent citations.
- On-page and content SEO: keyword and intent mapping, service pages, FAQs and
  articles, titles, headings and internal links.
- Answer engine optimisation (AEO): content shaped to be quoted in AI Overviews
  and featured snippets.
- Generative engine optimisation (GEO): entity consistency, third-party
  mentions and a citation footprint AI models draw on.

## The free report

- Crawls your website: homepage, service pages, schema, robots.txt, FAQ content
  and whether AI crawlers such as GPTBot are allowed in.
- Writes 30 to 50 questions a real customer in your niche and city would type.
- Runs every question through ChatGPT twice: once with web browsing on, once
  from its own knowledge. Both are scored separately.
- Returns an on-screen analysis and an A4 PDF with a prioritised fix list.
